messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved-pool 'resv-prod-3' queue length > 1200 (90th pct latency 4.2s). Autoscaler failures detected for pool-resizer. Pager created: PD-38921.
Elena (oncall): ack'ing. I'm taking pager. first look: which tenants on resv-prod-3? any enterprise customers impacted?
Marco: looks like BrightLeaf and KestrelFinance are pinned to that pool. BrightLeaf has 540 concurrent sessions queued. Kestrel ~180.
Jin (support): FYI BrightLeaf CSM is paged. they've reported slow responses from their API.
Elena (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) route BrightLeaf traffic to fallback dedicated-variant (lower throughput but available) 2) investigate autoscaler errors 3) try manual burst allocation from spare-resv pool.
Sahil: setting up a temporary route now. Elena, can you paste autoscaler logs?
Marco: grabbing logs.
Marco: ```
[2026-03-15T02:03:12Z] resizer-controller ERROR: scale-up failed: node-provision-timeout
[2026-03-15T02:03:12Z] resizer-controller WARN: quota-limit reached on cloud-project 'redwood-infer-prod'
[2026-03-15T02:03:13Z] resizer-controller ERROR: desiredReplicas=12 currentReplicas=4 reason="insufficient quota"
```
Elena (oncall): looks like cloud quota limits are blocking node provisioning. Ops-Bot, can you confirm current spare pool capacity?
Ops-Bot: spare-resv-pool status: total_gpus=48, allocated=46, free=2. Autoscaler requires 8 additional GPUs to satisfy target.
Sahil: routing change applied for BrightLeaf -> fallback-variant (model: rdm-small-v2) :white_check_mark: expecting degraded latency but avoiding queue growth.
Jin (support): told BrightLeaf we're failing over to a fallback model and actively applying mitigations. asking for expected degradation window.
Elena (oncall): manual temp workaround: evict long-running batch sessions from a noisy tenant "ml-experiments" that has been consuming burst slots. Marco, can you identify top noisy sessions?
Marco: pulling session list... ```
SESSION_ID  TENANT         GPU_MINUTES
s-az23     ml-experiments  1230
s-bk11     ml-experiments  980
s-rq09     brightleaf     45
```
Marco: evicting s-az23 and s-bk11 now.
Elena (oncall): eviction succeeded for 2 noisy sessions, freed 4 GPUs. Ops-Bot reports free GPUs=6 now. Still short of 8.
Sahil: opening a manual capacity request to cloud-quotas team for immediate ephemeral quota bump. tagging infra-requests.
Elena (oncall): progressive traffic shaping: lowering BrightLeaf concurrency cap to 80 to prevent further queue blow-up. Jin, please notify BrightLeaf of the concurrency cap change and ask them to retry throttled requests.
Jin (support): message to BrightLeaf sent: "We routed traffic to fallback model and applied a temporary concurrency cap (80). We're continuing to free capacity and will update in 15m. Apologies for the disruption"
Marco: autoscaler still logging quota errors, but with evictions + routing we reduced queue by ~420 in last 5m. current queue ~780.
Elena (oncall): ok. if quota bump doesn't arrive in 10m we'll trigger reserved-burst from our reserved-burst-account (manual allocation) and lift cap gradually. Sahil, if you get infra approval, I'll coordinate burst attach.
Ops-Bot: reserved-burst-account has 12 GPUs available for manual attach. Requires manual attach procedure: `resvctl attach --pool resv-prod-3 --gpus 12 --by opsteam` (audit log will record).
Sahil: infra-approved ephemeral attach in progress (confirmed by infra channel). attaching 8 GPUs now.
Elena (oncall): great. attach in progress, monitoring.
Ops-Bot: attach complete. resv-prod-3 free_gpus now 14; queue draining.
Marco: queue down to 210; 90th pct latency back to 1.1s.
Jin (support): BrightLeaf CSM reports error rate dropping. they've acknowledged the fallback and appreciate the updates.
Elena (oncall): summary for handoff to @Sahil for next shift: - Root cause: cloud quota prevented autoscaler from provisioning nodes; noisy tenant 'ml-experiments' consumed burst GPUs causing starvation. - Mitigations applied: evicted 2 noisy sessions (freed 4 GPUs), routed BrightLeaf to fallback model, applied temporary concurrency cap, manual attach of 8 GPUs from reserved-burst-account. - Current state: queue 210, latency healthy, reserved-pool has +12 GPUs attached. - Next steps: monitor for 30m, validate autoscaler behavior once quota bump persists, follow up with infra for permanent quota remediation, coordinate with support for post-incident customer email.
Sahil: taking over monitoring. I'll keep this thread updated. thanks @Elena. :thumbsup:
Elena (oncall): handing off. I'll add incident doc notes after rotation.
IncidentBot: Pager PD-38921 marked as 'mitigated' by Elena. Incident severity downgraded to SEV3.
Jin (support): I'll draft the customer-facing root cause note, drop it here for review.
Sahil: copying final checklist: - ensure autoscaler isn't in backoff - confirm cloud quota request approved - confirm ml-experiments tenant limits enforced - postmortem draft within 48h
Elena (oncall): noted. closing active mitigation. leaving watch for next 30m.
